chunks.arabic_text: وَ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ

translations.en: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم stood as a preacher and said:
"O people, beware of the green growth in dung heaps."

chunks.arabic_text: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَ مَا خَضْرَاءُ الدِّمَنِ

translations.en: It was said: "O Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, what is the green growth in dung heaps?"
He صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: "A beautiful woman in an evil place of upbringing."

en.summary: This hadith warns against being deceived by outward beauty when it is joined to a corrupt background and environment. It teaches moral caution in evaluating people, especially in family and marital considerations, by looking beyond appearance to character and upbringing.
en.seo_question: What does the hadith about "the green growth in dung heaps" mean?

key_terms.خَضْرَاءَ: green growth; a striking outward appearance
key_terms.الدِّمَنِ: dung heaps; a metaphor for a corrupt or vile setting
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman; the subject of the Prophetic example
key_terms.مَنْبِتِ: place of growth; origin or environment of upbringing
key_terms.السَّوْءِ: evil; moral corruption or bad background
